text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementZoologyElephants Think Before They ActIt’s a remarkable act of impulse controlDRBy Devin Reese1:00 PM CDT on September 9, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleAs humans, we value rational decision-making in which we resist impulses to make better decisions. This “inhibitory control” is also found in other primates and some birds. Such ability to self-regulate is not, however, known in elephants.
